issue_request: FHIR-26594 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested updating MedicationRequest.doNotPerform from a generic request-not-to-occur definition to wording saying the provider is asking the patient to stop taking or not start taking the specified medication, with an example.
initial_application: The request was initially applied by 7e6805e893 and merged by 400a4e8622 in June 2020, changing source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-spreadsheet.xml to the requested stop-or-not-start wording. The current active element source is source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml.
additional_context: Later Applied Pharmacy issues FHIR-47856 and FHIR-51848 intentionally replaced and expanded the doNotPerform guidance for R6: the current definition points to .reason, says no dispense or administration results, treats the request as standalone, and the comment now includes qualifier examples. FHIR-15941 is earlier background for adding doNotPerform to MedicationRequest. A checked-in medicationrequest.svg tooltip still has older text, but it is a generated-looking diagram artifact and the authoritative XML is correct.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scope XML source satisfies the seed's semantic request after considering later Applied work-group decisions, so restoring the literal 2020 wording would regress the specification.
